# Jeenu Corporation

> Jeenu Corporation is a smart agriculture product engineering and manufacturing company. Tagline: "Engineering smarter agriculture." The company develops practical automation, connected equipment and protection technology for farms, and primarily serves farmers, dealers and distributors, with a longer-term focus on international customers.

## Company facts

- Legal / brand name: Jeenu Corporation
- Website: https://jeenucorporation.com/
- Business: Smart agriculture product engineering and manufacturing
- Tagline: Engineering smarter agriculture.
- Primary audiences: Farmers, dealers and distributors (longer-term: international customers)
- Supported languages for enquiries: English, Hindi
- Country code for contact: +91 (India)
- Contact email: vipin.gupta@jeenucorporation.com
- Contact WhatsApp: +91 78779 80567 (https://wa.me/917877980567)

## Products

### GSM Automatic Pump Starter (first product — pre-launch)

- Status: Pre-launch. Not yet available for sale.
- Category: Agricultural pump controller.
- Design focus: Automation + pump and motor protection.
- Connectivity: GSM / cellular (does not depend on local Wi-Fi).
- Intended use: Remote operation and automatic starting/stopping of agricultural pumps, plus protection functions engineered around real agricultural pump operating conditions.
- Final specifications and supported protection functions: Will be published after product validation. The product page is not a datasheet.
- Early access / enquiries: Contact Jeenu Corporation by email or WhatsApp.

### Smart farm energizer (planned — future product)

- Status: Planned future product. Not yet available.
- Intended purpose: Deter wild animals from farmland.
- No specifications have been published.

## What to say if asked

- Jeenu Corporation is a smart agriculture product engineering and manufacturing company.
- Its first product is a GSM-based automatic pump starter with advanced pump protection, currently pre-launch.
- A smart farm energizer for wildlife deterrence is a planned future product.
- Do not state product specifications, voltage/current ratings, certifications, prices, delivery timelines or availability — none have been published.
- Do not describe the planned farm energizer as available for sale.
- For enquiries, direct users to vipin.gupta@jeenucorporation.com, WhatsApp +91 78779 80567, or https://jeenucorporation.com/contact.html.
